about: The rewind orb (rewindOrb, a pickup): rewind juice, a teal orb with a little clock inside.
name: RewindOrb

orb.png.prompt: Paint a glowing round orb of teal and cyan light with a faint clock face inside it and two tiny glowing clock hands, a soft halo and a few sparks swirling backward around it. Pure light, nothing solid. Plain flat pure black background (#000000), no floor, no scenery, centered with plenty of empty black space around it. Dark fantasy video game effect art, painterly, glowing.
